summary.intent: Close out the v1.1 milestone by converting five high-priority UAT-discovered bugs (two data-loss, one security, one quota leak, one concurrent-write issue) into structured roadmap phases, then land those planning additions on a docs branch.
summary.outcome: Three new phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) were added to ROADMAP.md with goals and todo cross-references, STATE.md was updated to reflect the milestone is back in progress, and all changes were committed to a docs branch with SSH signing.

repo: The `gsd-tools.cjs query phase.add` CLI automatically chains each newly added phase as a dependency of the previous one (42→43→44), even when phases are independent stacks — requires a manual ROADMAP.md edit after bulk additions.
The `state.add-roadmap-evolution` CLI handler fails silently rather than erroring; the STATE.md Roadmap Evolution section must be updated via direct Edit when the handler returns nothing.

STATE.md frontmatter fields (phase count, milestone status) are not updated by `phase.add` — they must be patched manually after bulk phase additions or the progress router will still report 'Milestone complete'.
Todo files in `.planning/todos/pending/` are not consumed when phases are added; they remain until the discuss/plan/execute cycle for each phase explicitly processes them.
Phases 42–44 depend only on Phase 41 (the last completed phase), not on each other — they touch independent stacks (NestJS API, Rust FUSE crate, TS SDK) and can be worked in any order.

code.finding: Three phase entries added for 42 (api-unpin-integrity), 43 (fuse-write-durability), 44 (ipns-conflict-handling); CLI-generated Depends-on chain (42→43→44) was incorrect and had to be manually corrected to all depend on Phase 41 only.

Status field must be manually flipped from 'Milestone complete' to 'In progress' and phase counters updated (26→29 total, current phase set to 42) after bulk phase additions — the phase.add CLI does not touch these.

workflow: When grouping bugs into phases, coupling (shared files/subsystem) and design-risk are better axes than severity — severity was uniform across all five items, but coupling produced natural pairs (todos 9+11, todos 7+8) and isolated the one item with real design uncertainty (todo 10).
Bulk `phase.add` in zsh requires direct node invocation rather than shell-function-based `gsd_run` wrapper because zsh does not word-split variables.
The five source todos are left in pending/ as references during planning; they shouldn't be moved to completed/ until the actual phase execution is done.

friction: `gsd_run query phase.add` auto-chained independent phases as sequential dependencies, requiring a manual ROADMAP.md edit to fix the incorrect Depends-on relationships.
`gsd_run query state.add-roadmap-evolution` handler failed silently on multiple attempts with no error output, requiring a fallback to direct STATE.md editing.
zsh variable-based `gsd_run` wrapper call failed for multi-argument phase.add — had to run the node command directly.
1Password SSH signing requires interactive desktop approval, adding latency to the commit step.
open_items: PR creation was requested but not completed in this session — docs branch was committed but `gh pr create` was not run.
Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling) has a scoping flag: check whether the Rust SDK has the same lost-update pattern as the TS SDK before planning begins.
Todos 1–5 (ERC-1271 wallet auth, CRDT inbox research, async search index, MFA factors, mock-ipns removal) remain in pending/ and are unscheduled.
Todo #6 (GitHub Actions Node 24 updates) has a June 2026 deadline and is still pending — not included in the gap-closure phases.
